description: A single low-magnification optical micrograph (no sub-panels), enclosed in a thin red rectangular border, showing a bright metallic matrix crossed by numerous dark, thin, closely spaced elongated bands. The bands run roughly parallel to one another along a diagonal direction across the field, while in the upper part and near the bottom edge the dark features become coarser, denser and more irregular, forming banded clusters that partly overlap. The contrast is that of a differentially etched surface: lighter regions separated by dark etched boundaries, with fine striations within the light areas. The elongated banding is the kind of deformation-induced slip-band / shear-band or banded (ghost) structure produced by heavy cold rolling, although the imaging mode (bright-field optical vs. colour-etched) cannot be confirmed from the pixels alone. No scale bar, magnification value, axis, legend, panel letter, sample label, or rolling-direction indicator is printed anywhere in the field. The supplied resolution is low and the image is visibly blurred/pixelated, so individual band thickness and spacing cannot be resolved. No caption was extracted, so the sample condition and deformation level are unstated in the text.

observations.observation: The figure consists of a single optical micrograph framed by a thin red rectangular border; there are no sub-panels, panel letters, or insets.
A bright, lightly etched metallic matrix is crossed by numerous dark, thin, elongated features.
The dark elongated features are roughly parallel to one another and oriented diagonally across the field of view.

In the upper portion and along the bottom edge of the field the dark features become coarser, denser and more irregular, forming overlapping band clusters, whereas the central region is brighter with finer striations.
The surface contrast is that of differential etching, with light regions bounded by dark etched boundaries.
No scale bar, magnification marker, calibration bar or numerical annotation is visible in the image.
No rolling-direction, sample-orientation or condition label is printed in the image.
The image is blurred and of low resolution; individual band thickness and inter-band spacing cannot be measured from the pixels.

The paper title identifies the material as Fe-30Mn-11Al-1.2C low-density steel studied during cold rolling, but the figure itself carries no printed sample label to confirm which rolling condition it shows.
